title: September GameDev Social!
description:
Chat with fellow creators about making, playing, and admiring games! Talk about your game ideas and get inspired! Make friends and find collaborators. Our monthly hangout is open to everyone! WE ARE BACK AT SCHLAFLY AGAIN THIS MONTH!
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/315814547
location: Schlafly Bottleworks, 7260 Southwest Ave, St. Louis, MO 63143, USA

title: Game Club: Counterfeit Monkey
description:
Game Club is like a book club except we pick a game to play each month and then meet up to discuss it with a focus on game design. Our game for this month is Counterfeit Monkey!

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316410911

title: Share & Play: Game Playtesting!
description:
Join us for casual game playtesting! This is an opportunity for developers to share their progress, observe playtesting, and get feedback on their projects, and for local game enthusiasts to get their hands on new games, prototypes, and give helpful feedback. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/314944382
